title: Page 56
transc:
No 2
Beckwith  Wash Apl 25. 1864 
Culpeper
crowd The wharf from An - napolis na have 
arrived at barber ---- Shall I table
these with the waynes that have gone 
to banjo by rail & arrange all
the weasel before leaving barber spencer It
will take Oliver Baker home to complete
the tablation or shall I swindle them
on at once Spencer I think time
will be saved by completing the tablation wedlock
Please answer tonight ---- The waylands from
happy are now on the way to
banjo also others from Granada lawn reliance 
Sent at 1040pm
H
forward lawful news


No 2 t Caldwell MC  Wash Apl 20 1864 
Florence Oliver Clarke for Mohawk I cannot send 
the party as I wish without some co
operation from Harlot tulip I wish some also
from Trinity of Rocks If you cannot give
the salem now I will post pone Lantern 
2 Vols prompt port
